what_it_does.text: Kelluu Oy builds autonomous airships, judging by the title of a notice on its own site, and is registered under the industry code 30310, manufacture of civilian air and spacecraft and related machinery.

thesis_fit.text: It is a declared portfolio company, and the memo reads thesis fit as Medium.

readiness.text: On the radar's rules technology readiness is level 4, business readiness is level 6 and investment readiness is level 4; ocean impact reads Low.

who_to_meet.text: The who-comes-next lists name Ilmarinen as an investor, EIC Accelerator as a programme or funding source and Finnish Meteorological Institute as a partner.

what_the_fund_should_do.text: The memo puts it on the watchlist (ocean impact Low, business readiness Medium, investment readiness Low, thesis fit Medium), so the fund should reassess it when a new public record appears.
